sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是本杰明·普林。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档聚焦设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会当DJ时，你每天晚上也要带着300件最珍贵的藏品去工作，你把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.

sentences.en: My original assignment was simply to look into how conspiracies about the presidential election were hurting the lives of individuals.
sentences.zh: 我最初的任务很简单，就是调查关于总统大选的阴谋论是如何伤害个人生活的。

sentences.en: You know, there's this conspiracy that claims that man never landed on the moon.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有一个阴谋论声称人类从未登上过月球。

sentences.en: I think you can make the argument, maybe because there was no social media or no Googling, that there isn't that one name or single person
sentences.zh: 我认为你可以这样争辩，也许是因为当时没有社交媒体，也没有谷歌搜索，所以没有那个唯一的姓名或个人

sentences.en: who we say was central to staging a fake moon landing.
sentences.zh: 被我们说成是策划虚假登月的核心人物。

sentences.en: Same with the flat earth theory.
sentences.zh: 地平说也是如此。

sentences.en: So far as I know, there isn't the villain or the victim.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这里面没有大反派，也没有受害者。

sentences.en: My name is Susan Dominus, and I'm a staff writer for The New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 我叫苏珊·多米努斯，我是《纽约时报杂志》的一名特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: I wrote a story about Eric Coomer, who was a senior figure in charge of security and strategy at Dominion Voting SysteMs.
sentences.zh: 我写了一篇关于埃里克·库默的报道，他曾是多米宁投票系统公司负责安全与战略的高级人物。

sentences.en: Dominion is one of the biggest election technology suppliers
sentences.zh: 多米宁是最大的选举技术供应商之一

sentences.en: Eric was the target of serious and prolonged threats because many subscribers to right-wing media and social media believed he was the central villain who created the technology
sentences.zh: 埃里克成了严重且长期威胁的目标，因为许多右翼媒体和社交媒体的订阅者认为他是核心反派，创造了这项技术

sentences.en: to allow Biden's supporters to rig the election.
sentences.zh: 来让拜登的支持者操纵选举。

sentences.en: It all started just days after the election.
sentences.zh: 这一切都始于选举结束后短短几天。

sentences.en: A host of a conservative podcast said that he'd heard Eric on an Antifa conference call, saying to others not to worry because he had made sure that Trump was not going to win.
sentences.zh: 一个保守派播客的主持人说，他曾听说埃里克在一次安提法（Antifa）的电话会议上，对其他人说不用担心，因为他已经确保了特朗普不会获胜。

sentences.en: Trump attorney Sidney Powell had already mentioned Dominion on Fox News.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的律师西德尼·鲍威尔已经在福克斯新闻上提到了多米宁。

sentences.en: Threats were pouring in to dozens of employees at Dominion.
sentences.zh: 大量的威胁涌向多米宁的数十名员工。

sentences.en: Eric has denied ever being on any such call, but his name began appearing in very graphic online posts in association with things like execution and suicide.
sentences.zh: 埃里克否认自己曾参加过任何此类电话会议，但他的名字开始出现在非常形象的在线帖子中，并与处决和自杀等内容联系在一起。

sentences.en: He was trending on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上登上了热门趋势。

sentences.en: An image of his face was tweeted out by Eric Trump.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·特朗普在推特上发布了一张他脸部的图片。

sentences.en: Eric worried that anybody who was very engaged in right-wing social media might even recognize him by face, and I don't think that was a paranoid fear.
sentences.zh: 埃里克担心，任何高度关注右翼社交媒体的人甚至可能一眼认出他，我认为这并非被害妄想。

sentences.en: The threats against Eric were serious enough that Dominion's security firm told him it was not safe for him to be in his own home.
sentences.zh: 对埃里克的威胁非常严重，以至于多米宁的安全公司告诉他，待在自己家里已经不再安全。

sentences.en: Eric was singled out because of his position at Dominion, but also because of anti-Trump posts he'd written on Facebook going back to 2016.
sentences.zh: 埃里克成为众矢之的不仅是因为他在多米宁的职位，还因为他早在2016年就在脸书上发表过反特朗普的帖子。

sentences.en: Those posts used very strong language and called Donald Trump things like autocratic and fasciSt.
sentences.zh: 这些帖子使用了非常激烈的言辞，称唐纳德·特朗普为独裁者和法西斯等。

sentences.en: And when I recognized that Eric had actually written those posts, his story became even more complicated and more interesting to me.
sentences.zh: 当我意识到埃里克确实写过这些帖子时，他的故事对我和我的读者来说变得更加复杂也更加有趣。

sentences.en: In many ways, this is a tale about how one piece of information, often one that contains a kernel of truth, gets used to amplify other details and storylines
sentences.zh: 从许多方面来看，这是一个关于一条信息——通常包含一小部分真相——如何被用来放大其他细节和故事线的故事

sentences.en: that are very much not true.
sentences.zh: 而这些细节和故事线完全是子虚乌有。

sentences.en: So here's my story.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我的故事。

sentences.en: It was already late on November 9th when Eric Coomer, then the director of product strategy and security for Dominion Voting Systems,
sentences.zh: 11月9日天色已晚时，时任多米宁投票系统公司产品战略与安全总监的埃里克·库默

sentences.en: left his temporary office on Daly Plaza in Chicago and headed back to the hotel where he'd been staying for the previous few weeks.
sentences.zh: 离开了他在芝加哥戴利广场的临时办公室，返回他过去几周一直住着的酒店。

sentences.en: Both the plaza and the hotel had the eerie, post-apocalyptic feel of urban life during the pandemic, compounding the sense of disorientation and apprehension he felt
sentences.zh: 广场和酒店都有一种大流行期间城市生活特有的诡异、后末日般的氛围，这加剧了他的迷失感和忧虑感

sentences.en: as he made his way up to his room.
sentences.zh: 当他一路走回自己的房间时。

sentences.en: Earlier that evening, a colleague sent him a link to a video of Coomer speaking at a conference with a menacing comment below it.
sentences.zh: 那天早些时候，一位同事给他发了一个视频链接，里面是库默在一次会议上讲话的画面，下面还附有一条充满威胁的评论。

sentences.en: Hi, Eric.
sentences.zh: 嗨，埃里克。

sentences.en: We know what you did, the commenter wrote.
sentences.zh: 我们知道你干了什么，评论者写道。

sentences.en: That link eventually led Coomer to a second video, which he watched in his hotel room.
sentences.zh: 那个链接最终把库默引向了第二个视频，他在酒店房间里观看了这段视频。

sentences.en: What he saw, he quickly realized, was something that was likely to wreck his life, hurt his employer, and possibly erode trust in the electoral process.
sentences.zh: 他很快意识到，他所看到的这一切很可能会毁了他的生活，伤害他的雇主，并可能侵蚀人们对选举过程的信任。

sentences.en: Over the past decade,
sentences.zh: 在过去十年里，

sentences.zh: 51岁的库默帮助多米宁成长为美国最大的投票机和软件供应商之一。

sentences.en: He was a gifted programmer, known to be serious about his work, but informal about almost everything else, prone to profanities, with a sense of humor that could have blunt force.
sentences.zh: 他是一位天赋异禀的程序员，对待工作严肃认真，但几乎在其他所有事情上都很随性，满口脏话，其幽默感具有一种钝刀切肉般的杀伤力。

sentences.en: Coomer, who traveled around the world for competitive endurance bike races, would have blended in on the campus of Google, just one in a crowd of nonconformist tech types.
sentences.zh: 库默曾周游世界参加竞技耐力自行车赛，他如果走在谷歌的校园里会显得毫无违和感，不过是那群富有叛逆精神的技术人才中的普通一员。

sentences.en: In the more corporate business of elections, he stood out for the full-sleeve tattoos on his arms, one of Francis Bacon's screaming popes, some Picasso bulls,
sentences.zh: 但在相对更加成熟稳重的选举业务中，他却因为手臂上的整袖纹身而格外显眼，那上面有弗朗西斯·培根笔下尖叫的教皇、一些毕加索的公牛，

sentences.en: and the half-inch holes in his ears where he once wore what are known as plugs.
sentences.zh: 还有他耳朵上曾经戴过被称为扩大耳塞的半英寸耳洞。

sentences.zh: 库默习惯了在选举后的认证阶段连轴转地工作，但那年11月的压力正在迅速积聚。

sentences.en: Donald Trump was demanding recounts.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普正要求重新计票。

sentences.zh: 代表特朗普竞选团队的律师西德尼·鲍威尔出现在福克斯新闻上，在没有证据的情况下声称，多米宁拥有一个将选票从特朗普转给拜登的算法。

sentences.en: The video Coomer watched in his hotel room represented a new development in Dominion's troubles.
sentences.zh: 库默在酒店房间里观看的视频代表了多米宁麻烦中的一个新进展。

sentences.en: It was that day's episode of the Conservative Daily Podcast, a program previously unknown to Coomer, which had been posted to YouTube.

sentences.zh: 奥托后来透露自己是科罗拉多州的企业家乔·奥尔德曼，他声称自己找到了证明多米宁存在舞弊的铁证。

sentences.zh: 他告诉听众，在选举之前他并不觉得多米宁的这个埃里克会是谁，直到选举结束后，一位朋友给他发了一条关于选举麻烦的脸书帖子
